title: Mitchell confessed blue orbs to 'the Spaceman'

tellings.quote: quotes an anonymous source which who he calls the spaceman who was apparently very close personal friends with Ed Mitchell. And he says Ed Mitchell confessed to him that yeah, we saw these blue orb like lights following us or you know from the lunar surface

plain: The Apollo 14 astronaut Edgar Mitchell is said to have privately admitted that during his 1971 moon landing, he and his crew saw blue, orb-like lights following them from the lunar surface. The physicist Maaneli Derakhshani relays this from In Plain Sight, a book by the journalist Ross Coulthart, which quotes an unnamed source called "the Spaceman" who was a close friend of Mitchell's. If true, it would mean astronauts saw something unexplained on the moon and kept quiet.
